shots.purpose: Open on the isthmus map: two oceans, the canal line stepping up over the ridge to Gatun
shots.claim: the canal lifts ships about 26 meters above sea level to cross the terrain
shots.evidence: full-bleed Panama map: recognizable isthmus silhouette, canal line with lock steps, Gatun Lake, both oceans labeled
shots.motion_reason: slow push-in so the staircase reads as the subject

subject_contract.expected_subject: parchment map of the Panamanian isthmus with a stepped canal line joining two oceans

one_second.relationship: the canal climbs over the continent on water

shots.purpose: Show why a flat ditch fails: hatched rock spine and a swinging Pacific tide
shots.claim: terrain and tide made a sea-level canal impractical
shots.evidence: map card: hatched rock band across the spine, dashed flat-channel idea crossed out, tidal arrows at the Pacific coast
shots.motion_reason: near-static drift so the barrier is the information

subject_contract.expected_subject: parchment map with a hatched rock spine and tidal arrows at the Pacific coast

one_second.relationship: rock and tide kill the flat channel

shots.purpose: Show the lock cross-section filling by gravity from the lake
shots.claim: locks fill by gravity from Lake Gatun with no pumping
shots.evidence: cross-section card: chamber with ship, water rising from a culvert fed by Gatun, gravity arrow down the supply line
shots.motion_reason: slow rise drift so the fill reads as the motion
shots.transition_reason: cut into the water toll map

subject_contract.expected_subject: parchment lock cross-section: chamber, ship, culvert inflow from the lake

one_second.relationship: the lake pours the ship uphill

shots.purpose: Show the cost: fresh water draining from the locks to both oceans every transit
shots.claim: each ship transit discharges huge volumes of freshwater to the ocean
shots.evidence: map card: drain arrows from the lock steps toward both coasts, droplet marks, rain-only refill into Gatun
shots.motion_reason: slow drift down the drain arrows

subject_contract.expected_subject: parchment map with fresh-water drain arrows from the locks toward both oceans

one_second.relationship: every transit spends the lake's fresh water

shots.purpose: Show the drought stakes: lake level falling below the draft line
shots.claim: drought lowers Gatun and forces transit restrictions
shots.evidence: gauge card: normal lake band, dashed drought line far below, ship hull sitting deep with draft marks
shots.motion_reason: slow downward drift with the falling level

subject_contract.expected_subject: parchment gauge: lake levels with a dashed drought line and a deep-riding ship hull

one_second.relationship: when the lake falls, the ships must ride lighter

shots.purpose: Land the argument: side basins handing most of the water back, dusk calm over the staircase
shots.claim: the expanded locks recycle roughly 60 percent of lockage water
shots.evidence: dusk reprise of the lock with stepped side basins and return arrows, calm palette
shots.motion_reason: slow pull-out, the frame settles as the argument does

subject_contract.expected_subject: parchment-plate lock with stepped side basins and return arrows, dusk warmth

one_second.relationship: the staircase hands most of its water back
